sourceNotes: 新增 macOS 15 及以上可选网络监视器
新增连接世界地图，首次使用时按需下载公共 IP 地理数据库，之后离线查询
网络监视器通过独立组件按需启用，首次使用需安装组件并按系统提示授权，安装需要管理员账户
功能设置分为基础功能与可选功能，基础监控可分别关闭
功能启用与菜单栏展示分开管理，加入菜单栏时自动启用对应功能，移出菜单栏不会关闭功能
显示器亮度、对比度与音量控制改为单独开关，关闭后仍可查看显示器信息，并保留独立的菜单栏信息入口
卸载应用改为可选功能，新安装默认关闭，从旧版本升级时保持开启
修复网络组件替换后连接旧服务、过滤设置失败后持续显示空数据
修复 Homebrew 清理预览在系统繁忙时可能超过时限仍未停止的问题

en: Add an optional Network Monitor for macOS 15 or later, with an overview of observed new connections and grouping by app, process, domain, country or region, search, active-connection filtering, pause and resume; all traffic is allowed, communication content is never inspected, and connection records remain in memory only

Add a world map of connections; download the public IP geolocation database only when first enabled, then look up locations offline, using representative country-level locations rather than precise device locations

Enable network monitoring through an independent on-demand component; first use requires an administrator account to install it and approval in macOS, with component management, independent update checks and complete removal available in XStats; its background service starts on demand and exits when idle If you used a preview network component, uninstall it from component management and enable it again following macOS prompts to move to the regional API update source.

Separate Basic and Optional Features and allow individual monitoring modules to be disabled, stopping collection, related alerts and new history records while preserving existing history; system widgets refresh independently, and disabling thermals first returns manual fan control to macOS, retaining monitoring and an error message if that fails

Manage feature activation separately from menu bar visibility: adding an entry enables its feature, while removing it leaves the feature enabled; AI Usage, Audio and Displays also offer direct menu bar display options, and optional features are grouped by purpose

Control display brightness, contrast and volume through a separate feature switch; disabling parameter controls keeps display information available and preserves its independent information-only menu bar entry

Make Uninstaller optional and disabled by default for new installations, while keeping it enabled when upgrading from older versions; disabling it cancels scans and pending confirmations and releases observers, while already-started removal operations finish normally

Fix connections to an old service after component replacement, empty data after filter configuration failures and component window messages not refreshing after approval timeout; check protocol compatibility before installation and order domain and country or region groups by time
Fix Homebrew cleanup previews that could continue beyond their timeout while the system was busy
